question: How many recitations of the six-syllabled mantra are prescribed as alternatives?
premises: One may recite the six-syllabled mantra a thousand times.
Alternatively, one may recite it six hundred times.
inference: The ritual allows either one thousand or six hundred recitations of the six-syllabled mantra.
plain_english: One should indeed recite the six-syllabled mantra a thousand times, or even six hundred.
